en: Through knowledge, may we find salvation.
Nope, nobody who can teach ye herbalism out here.  I think ye'll have better luck in Ironforge though.

Your next choice awaits.$B$BYou alone have defeated a terrible beast that has been ravaging the countryside, taking its ear as a trophy.  You later learn that your liege had offered a reward for the beast's death, and that a kind but destitute knight who you know is trying to support a family by meager means claims the beast's kill as his own.  You have no real need for money yourself, but you know that the destitute knight is lying for his own personal gain.$B$BMake your choice.
When you next go to the Molten Core, kill a Firelord for me, will you?

Something plagues this tower. I've fallen ill and the other Venture Co. employees that work near or in the tower have also become sick.$B$BJust last week, two of our patrollers died, only to instantly come back to life as mindless drones!$B$BThe lifeforce is draining from my body. I can feel myself losing control. Urges taking over... Bad urges... *Fizzule slaps himself in the face* Not yet... Listen... Mine is a position of power. This position privies me to some sensitive information.
How many more supplies are needed for the next upgrade?
Break... you!!
They're going to show fireworks all night long.  From 6PM until dawn, the sky will blaze over Booty Bay!
Did you hear that?
Caught unaware? How?
If I make a gift collection, what do I do with it?
Greetings.  I'm a warlock trainer, and you're a warlock.
Search this rubble.
Rut'theran Ferry
Your existence is acknowledged. <The relic turns to dust. Your head throbs with newfound wisdom. Something evil lurks in the heart of the mountain.>
You have failed to protect me from the apes!

Fishmaster Bassbait has had the waters here seeded with high quality Tastyfish so he can have his tournament.

Once he gets his winner, I will give you silver for each five Tastyfish you bring me!
Still no sign of the 2nd Battalion from Stormwind.  Reports are coming in of Shadowhide movement in the Northeast.
Ye should take a look in Ironforge if ye have yer mind set on enchanting.  I think I saw a shop over by the gryphon master last time I was up there.
Intruders!  Slay them!
A rogue?  Hmmm... well, I've heard that Keryn Sylvius hangs around those shady types.  You might want to talk to her and see what you can learn.

Yer looking to learn how to use a new weapon are ye?  Well, ye should be talking to Bixi or Buliwyf over at the Timberline Arms weapon shop then $glad : lass;.  They know their weapons from axes to... uh... zweihanders.
Thanks for the information, Frankal.
Can you get this $n off me?
Hearthglen?? But...
No luck with the Twilight's Hammer deserter?  Check the mountains to the southeast thoroughly.  There are numerous rumors of a mysterious hermit living there.
Only a fool walks into a den of thieves unaware. That fool rarely walks out...
What will we do with them, master? They are of no use to us anymore.
Good idea!

We finally understood what the screams were from. The Butcher exposed us to pain that we did not know existed. He used us in countless experiments, attempting to devise a plague.$B$BThe days turned to weeks. We would have died on the first day had it not been for that cruel bastard keeping us alive through magical means.
Horrifying.
I would like to go to the battleground.
Teach me how to create and apply a Heavy Mageweave Bandage, Doctor.
Wow!  These kegs are filled with powerful stuff!  They lift me right out of my boots!
The Southshore Crier grabs the back of his neck and his eyes go wide.
And for our gods?
Molthor sees all, $r.
Bluegill Marsh north of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands holds many locked boxes from the wrecks offshore that have washed ashore.
How easy it was to manipulate you into recovering the last Suntara stone from those imbeciles of the Twilight's Hammer.
Thank you, all. I shall return again in about a week.
